text:
Sam (Account): Customer request: full CAIQ export + a one-page shared-responsibility matrix specifically calling out KMS behavior (rotation, revocation) for a 2-week POC. They also want an itemized POC quote for Dedicated vs hosted-with-CMK. Can we own?

Devon (Security): I can take CAIQ and the SR matrix. Need to confirm: do they require key-revocation testing during POC (i.e., we demonstrate that revoking grants blocks decryption)? That changes onboarding steps.

Rosa (Solutions): From kickoff call: they want to verify revocation and key residency (EU primary, failover to US allowed only if keys replicated). Traffic ~5 rps, 8k token generations, want isolated logs.

Ibrahim (Infra): Operational constraints: revocation test requires us to have customer grant + an account admin who can revoke and confirm results. For Dedicated POC with CMK, we'll do VPC peering + KMS grants; hosted-with-CMK needs IAM role + audit export. Setup ~48-72h normally.

eva-bot: CAIQ template (internal): https://redwood.internal/security/ca iq/exports/CAIQ-2026-v2 (note: attach CSV with controls)

Devon (Security): Draft of SR matrix (plain language):
- Redwood: operates model instances, manages host OS/patches, enforces TLS in transit, and stores platform artifacts encrypted with AES-256.
- Customer: controls input data, maintains client-side API keys, and manages KMS keys when CMK selected (including rotation and revocation).
- CMK nuance: Redwood can be granted decrypt/encrypt permissions but does NOT persist plaintext key material. If customer revokes grants, decryption fails and calls will error until grants are reissued.

Rosa (Solutions): CAIQ answer snippet for key management control: "We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and GCP KMS. Key usage is performed by Redwood with customer-issued grants/roles. All KMS API calls are logged and available to the customer for audit. Key material never leaves the customer's KMS."

Ibrahim (Infra): Quick POC cost sketch (rough):
- Dedicated POC: 1x A10G-equivalent reserved pool + private networking, KMS integration, storage, egress, and a 48h onboarding SLA = USD 16,200 for 2 weeks.
- Hosted-with-CMK: shared pool + CMK integration + logs export = USD 2,400 for 2 weeks.
- Add-on: if customer requires a live key-revocation demo with extended engineering support, add a one-time setup/ops fee USD 2,500.

Sam (Account): Nice. Devon: can you flag any CAIQ controls that look problematic for us given EU-first keys + revocation demo? Rosa: add a 1-page runbook (VPC peering steps, KMS grant policy example, smoke test). Ibrahim: please break down costs into line items (GPU hours, storage, egress, ops hours).

Devon (Security): Early flags:
- CCM-ENC-REG (key residency): AMBER because we rely on customer's KMS region settings; we can document behavior but cannot force KMS geo-placement.
- CCM-OPS-HOST (host access): AMBER on hosted; GREEN on Dedicated/Private with reduced host access per SLA.
- CCM-SEC-AUDIT (evidence): GREEN — we can provide KMS usage logs and platform audit logs but need customer's SIEM ingest for full end-to-end evidence.
I'll export annotated CAIQ with R/Y/G and short rationales.

Rosa (Solutions): Runbook TODOs: include IAM/grant JSON example, curl smoke test for generation, and exact steps to revoke a grant and verify fail. Example IAM snippet I'll paste in doc.

Ibrahim (Infra): I'll produce the itemized quote spreadsheet and link it here when ready. ETA: 4pm PT.

Sam (Account): Great — tell the customer 48h turnaround. If they insist on key revocation demo during POC, note the extra ops fee and 72h lead time. Thanks team :thumbsup:
